command:
set -u
printf 'NOW='; date -Is
for d in /workspace/omega_runtime/current /workspace/oMEGA /workspace/omega; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    printf 'DIR=%s\n' "$d"
    git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
    git -C "$d" status --short --branch 2>/dev/null || true
    git -C "$d" remote -v 2>/dev/null || true
    test -f "$d/config/assembly.json" && echo ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST_PRESENT=1 || echo ASSEMBLY_MANIFEST_PRESENT=0
    test -f "$d/omega/assembly.py" && echo ASSEMBLY_MODULE_PRESENT=1 || echo ASSEMBLY_MODULE_PRESENT=0
  fi
done
printf '%s\n' '---SUPERVISOR---'
if [ -f /workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json ]; then cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json; else echo SUPERVISOR_STATUS_MISSING; fi
printf '%s\n' '---ASSEMBLY_STATUS---'
if [ -f /workspace/omega_runtime/state/ASSEMBLY_STATUS.json ]; then cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/ASSEMBLY_STATUS.json; else echo ASSEMBLY_STATUS_MISSING; fi
printf '%s\n' '---OMEGA_PROCESSES---'
ps -eo pid,lstart,args | grep -E '[p]ython3? -m omega|[o]mega-supervisor|[s]upervisor.py' || true
